# 解线性方程组 $Ax=b$

## 消元法和回代

[sympy 里如何给一个矩阵加一列向量，就是加一个解向量组成增广矩阵？](../appendices/2.qmd#sympy-里如何给一个矩阵加一列向量就是加一个解向量组成增广矩阵)

(1) $Ax=b$ 只有唯一解

```{python}
#| output: asis

from sympy import Matrix
from books.assets.reading_lab_display import display

A = Matrix([
    [2, 3],
    [4, 2],
])

display(A.inv())

b = Matrix([5, 6])

aug = A.row_join(b)

display(aug)

display(*aug.rref())
```

[这个 rref 的第二行怎么看？](../appendices/2.qmd#这个-rref-的第二行怎么看)

(2) $Ax=b$ 无解

```{python}
#| output: asis

from sympy import Matrix
from books.assets.reading_lab_display import display

A = Matrix([
    [2, 3],
    [4, 6],
])

b = Matrix([6, 15])

aug = A.row_join(b)

display(aug)

display(*aug.rref())
```

(3) $Ax=b$ 有无穷多解

```{python}
#| output: asis

from sympy import Matrix
from books.assets.reading_lab_display import display

A = Matrix([
    [2, 3],
    [4, 6],

b = Matrix([6, 12])

aug = A.row_join(b)

display(aug)

display(*aug.rref())
```

### 回代解法 $Ux=c$

### 把 A 转化成 U，b 转化成 c

```{python}
#| output: asis

from books.assets.reading_lab_display import display

import sympy as sp

E21 = sp.Matrix([
    [1, 0, 0],
    [-2, 1, 0],
    [0, 0, 1],
])
E31 = sp.Matrix([
    [1, 0, 0],
    [0, 1, 0],
    [-1, 0, 1],
])
E32 = sp.Matrix([
    [1, 0, 0],
    [0, 1, 0],
    [0, -1, 1],
])

res = E32 * E31 * E21
display(res)

A = sp.Matrix([
    [2, 3, 4],
    [4, 11, 14],
    [2, 8, 17],
])
b = sp.Matrix([19, 55, 50])
aug = A.row_join(b)
display("aug", aug)

display("E21*aug", E21 * aug)
display("E31*E21*aug", E31 * E21 * aug)

display("res*aug", res * aug)
display("A.inv()", A.inv())

L, U, perm = A.LUdecomposition()
display("L", L, "U", U)

display("L.inv() == res", L.inv() == res)
```
